jsesh.fontEditor.gui
Class ToolContext

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.fontEditor.gui.ToolContext
public class ToolContext
extends java.lang.Object

Data manipulated by a tool.

A Tool will typically manipulate the view and the model, and then build a command which will be passed to the context for execution.
